$comment: Tony's Pizza Fantasy — locked palette. 32 shared colours, plus a narrowly typed per-family extension. Every generated asset is quantized to these values during processing; this file is the mechanism that keeps independently generated batches looking like one world. Do not add, remove, or edit a color without regenerating every affected asset.
status: PROVISIONAL — locked on approval of art test batch B0

ink.role: Outlines, text, shadow anchors. Warm-biased so it never reads as pure black.

wood.role: Paneling, tables, counter, booth frames, floors.

red.role: Checkered cloth, vinyl booths, sauce, signage.

paper.role: Menus, newspaper, receipts, napkins, pizza-box print.

amber.role: Incandescent light, warm key, cheese, brass, lamp glow.

blue.role: Night, cool ambient fill, Detroit-adjacent jerseys, cold neon.

violet.role: Deep shadow in the underground, epic treatment, neon accent.

skin.role: Avatar and character skin. Four steps spanning a usable range. Managers select a step; it is not tied to any other palette role.

familyExtensions.$comment: Colours available to ONE asset family only. The shared 32 stay shared; a family extension is how a measured coverage gap gets closed without rewriting art that does not have the gap. See docs/PALETTE_FIDELITY_BOUNDARY.md.

zone.$comment: The room's own four. `zone_*` assets are large painterly interiors whose dominant surfaces — walls, ceiling, floor, counter — live in a warm mid range the shared 32 do not reach: measured, the shell used the paper ramp for 0.1% of its pixels and the amber (lamp-glow) ramp for 27.3%, at a mean quantization error of 35 of a possible 441. These four were chosen by weighted k-means over the worst-served warm pixels, not by eye. They take the shell to 21.6 and the counter front from 36.4 to 20.1. Scoped to `zone` by commissioner decision 2026-08-05: applied globally they also rewrote all twelve approved Batch B collectibles by up to 39%, which is a re-approval event rather than a defect fix.

semantic.$comment: Semantic roles map to ramp entries. Never introduce a new hex for a semantic role.
semantic.shadowRule: one step darker within the same ramp — never ink-900, never pure black

rarity.$comment: Rarity must never be communicated by color alone. These reinforce the frame geometry and label required by 06 §8.

prohibited.$comment: Never sample or introduce these, regardless of what a generation returns.
prohibited.note: Pure black flattens the warm bias; pure white blows out against paper-white. Both are common image-model defaults and must be quantized away.
